ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity background (dark grey/black) covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, contrasted with high-intensity foreground clusters (white/cream) covering approximately 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity pigmentation across the central and medial fluke regions. High-intensity contiguous geometric blobs are concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edge. A series of high-intensity linear paths are visible across the left and right interior lobes.
